text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Morning~!
You're up early, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No, I just woke up on my own...
Guess I slept too much...
It's surprisingly hard to just keep resting endlessly, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
When you take a really good, proper break,
you actually get bored surprisingly fast, huh?

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I get it... You just want to move around.
Back when I only had two days off a month,
I used to dread coming back to work...

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Was all my effort directed the wrong way?
To only realize it now...
I'm so stupid..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Glad you figured it out.
Feeling a bit more clearheaded now?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Phew......
"Recovery run" complete.
Blood circulation and heart rate are both optimal.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehehe~! Looking good♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Once you recover,
why don't you try incorporating something like this?

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Like... what?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It's “active rest.” When you're tired, light exercise is said to help flush out fatigue substances faster.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right, right!
It's important, so take it to heart♪
You might just feel like running again, you know?

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"There's a way like that too...?
If I can... make a comeback, I wonder if it'll help..."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Words from peers close in age really do
resonate best, after all.
If this helps them start looking forward, even a little bit...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Being injury-prone also means
you're so talented that you tend not to notice
your own fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
She's capable of doing it.
No matter how many times she falls, there's no reason she can't catch up.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Wake up. Stand on your feet.
You can still make it in time—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh! We meet again! How've you been lately?
Did you try out the Wagahai-style stretches
I taught you the other day?

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I've been doing it in my room...
Plus a little bit of jogging, too...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh, really?!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, the doctor said I was 'good to run now,' so I was just testing it out, but...

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... This level won't cut it
in a race...
Not yet...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Not yet...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, my,
so this is where you were♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I've gathered some books on rehabilitation.
I brought them to your room,
so please read them if you feel up to it♪

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Even the young proprietress...
She really didn't have to bother.
Doing all this for me...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: ‘I cannot live up to them’... you say?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I understand very well
how awful that makes you feel.
I was the same way back in my racing days, after all.

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-is that so...
Haha... I was wondering how you knew...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Um... why not try taking it a bit easier?
It's okay if it doesn't work out.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"Finding out that 'this method didn't work'
is a valuable gain in itself."

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um... Could I at least hear about
the rehab plan?
I don't know if I can do it, but...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah...!
I can handle this better than I thought...?
Man, it really does feel great...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right!?
That's what being an Umamusume is all about!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
I'm so glad I can run again...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I believe in miracles!
After all, I'm "absolute"!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey...
If I made a comeback...
Do you think everyone would be surprised?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course they'd be shocked~!
After getting injured twice, you came back and then...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then, if I win!
Man! That'd be so super cool!!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah...
If we could pull that off... it'd be a miracle—

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm...
still dreaming...
Thinking, 'what if I could really do it?'

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
Then let's aim for it!
A "miraculous comeback"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this.
We can overcome it, as many times as it takes!
Absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Proprietress...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Right, time to retool the menu.
You go warm up too.
Things are gonna get busy!
And she began her full-scale rehabilitation.

Taking one step forward, one step back, continuing to put in the effort...
With each passing day, the light in those eyes grew stronger and—

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
――Thank you for everything.
I'll continue doing my best once I'm back at the academy!
And then...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —400 meters remaining! Whoa, here she comes charging in! A closing burst that makes you forget she just returned from recuperation!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Hang in there...!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: I'm going!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Pushing through the middle, she effortlessly surges ahead!
Her first victory in an entire year!
And she crosses the gooooal!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I wooooon~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes...! It was a magnificent victory...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...! Teio-sa...
Error encountered... visual feed, compromised...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah! Ugh... me too...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh... ufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
――Despite having not raced in quite a long time,
that was a brilliant victory!
Tell us, what is the secret behind your comeback?!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The secret is... let's see.
The support and expectations of those around me, perhaps.
That is what led me to my "recuperation."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: "Recuperation? So you mean something like a specialized rehabilitation facility or hospital?"

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "No... it's a hot spring!"

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"There's a hot spring with amazing water quality! The facilities are great and it's so comfortable.
But more than that—"

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“‘It's thanks to the landladies and everyone in the hot spring village!
Everyone's hospitality supported me.’”

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Both my body and soul have been healed...
It made me look forward and think, 'I'll give it my all again!'

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Just where on earth is that hot spring?!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Yukoma Hot Spring Resort—!"

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "It's the greatest resort facility that helped me get back on my feet!"
